items.title: Theia IDE
items.description: Run any language, supports VS Code Extensions, integrates flexible AI Support, based on the Theia Platform, integrates the Monaco Editor .

items.title: Gitpod
items.description: Run any language on a full Linux VM complete with terminals, GitHub and Git integration, content assist, go-to-definition, linting, live collaboration, custom Docker workspaces, and integrated code review support.

items.title: CodeSandbox
items.description: Run JavaScript with starting templates for React, Vue, Angular, Preact and more with full intellisense, lint error checking and live collaborative editing.

items.title: WebAssembly Studio
items.description: Run C, Rust, Wat, or AssemblyScript code as WebAssembly in the browser.

items.title: Colaboratory
items.description: Run Python in a Jupyter notebook with ML libraries and free GPUs for running experiments.

items.title: AWS Cloud9
items.description: Run any language on a full VM complete with a terminal built on Ace Editor .

items.title: Remix
items.description: Run Solidity with a compiler, debugger, Static Analyzer for security, and direct access to Ethereum main network and testing networks.

items.title: Atheos
items.description: Run most languages using a PHP/Browser based IDE with a terminal, git integration, and syntax highlighting.

items.title: CodeEnvy
items.description: Run any language on a full VM complete with Eclipse Che .

items.title: Dockside
items.description: Self host parallel access-controlled development containers complete with the Theia IDE and terminal, for developing in any language and multiple architectures, within choice of Docker runtimes; stage running code publicly or securely on own domains over HTTPS.

items.title: Wide
items.description: Run Go with full intellisense code-completion, expression-info, and jump to declaration.

items.title: Superblocks Lab
items.description: Run Solidity with a built-in browser Ethereum blockchain VM, Metamask integration (deployments to Testnet/Mainnet), transaction logger and live code your WebApp, powered by Monaco Editor.

items.title: Snack Expo
items.description: Run JavaScript with React Native in the browser and on your mobile iOS or Android.

items.title: GitHub Codespaces
items.description: Run any language with VS Code complete with terminal, debugger, GitHub Copilot, version control, settings sync, and extensions.

items.title: Try It Online
items.description: Run snippets from over 300 languages including esoteric code-golf languages.

items.title: Kotlin-Playgrounds
items.description: Run Kotlin snippets with auto-completion, type checking and automatically translate Java to Kotlin code.

items.title: Scastie
items.description: Run Scala snippets with support of choosing different Scala versions, using any public library, configuring SBT settings, sharing a code snippet, embedding it into your website, etc.

items.title: SQLFiddle
items.description: Run snippets of MySQL, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and Oracle.

items.title: TypeScript Playground
items.description: Run snippets of TypeScript with tsconfig options and full intellisense.

items.title: Glot
items.description: Run snippets from over 30 languages as docker containers including C#, Kotlin, Julia, Go, and Ruby.

items.title: PasteRack
items.description: Run Racket snippets with support for sample and recent snippets.

items.title: JS Bin
items.description: Run snippets in HTML/CSS/JS/TS, provides Codecasting.

items.title: LiveCodes
items.description: Run snippets in 90+ languages/frameworks, including React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Typescript, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP and many more. Runs client-side with no backend. Projects can be shared, exported, deployed and embedded. Free AI code assistant.

items.title: Flems
items.description: Run snippets in HTML/CSS/JS without a connection to the server (after page load).

items.title: Popcode
items.description: Run snippets in HTML/CSS/JS for use in the classroom, with student-friendly error messages and offline editing.
